links.comparator_used: Algorithm-identified patients with weekly peer-comparison referral reports and referral at clinician discretion (no default orders, accountable justification or coordinator outreach)
links.outcome: Completed palliative care consultation within 12 weeks of enrollment
links.effect: 43.9% (130/296) intervention vs 8.3% (22/266) control; adjusted OR 8.9 (95% CI 5.5-14.6; P < .001). Systemic therapy within 14 days of death: 6.5% vs 16.1% (adjusted OR 0.3, 95% CI 0.1-0.7; P = .05). No differences in quality of life, feeling heard and understood, or late hospice referral.
links.quote: There were 130 of 296 patients (43.9%) randomized to the intervention group and 22 of 266 (8.3%) randomized to the control group who completed PC visits (adjusted odds ratio, 8.9 [95% CI, 5.5-14.6]; P < .001).

design_hint: EHR default orders with opt-out and accountable justification for algorithm-identified patients
